description: Get the whole derivatives market's open interest hour by hour over up to 30 days (default 30): each venue's crypto and RWA open interest, each asset class's total (crypto, equities, commodities, ETFs, pre-IPO, indices, FX), the largest assets of each class with their split by venue, every asset over $100,000 now, and BTC's hourly price. One side in US dollars; MEXC, BingX and any venue with no reading at the last hour (Deribit, 8 hours late) left out, listed in left_out; tradeXYZ counted as Hyperliquid. For one coin's open interest by venue use get_futures_data.

days.description: Days of hourly series, ending at the last whole hour.

name: get_open_interest_market
title: Open interest across the market
